newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates fall at mid-session.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates fall at mid-session.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates fell at mid-session on Wednesday as liquidity remained loose in the banking system and dealers saw room for further declines.

The overnight interbank rate was at 6.341 percent against Tuesday's 6.437 close -- still far outside the central bank's 5.00-5.5 percent target zone -- with 30-day commercial paper down to 6.35 percent against 6.45-6.50.

Dealers said banking system's liquidity was still loose despite Tuesday's income tax payments and the central bank's planned issue of T$5 billion negotiable certificates of deposit later on Wednesday.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 6.0890-0900 against 6.0785-0800.
